adapter-entry-point.method: Accepted Workspace CLI Capability validation and clean staged Provider Entry Point generation

governed-target.method: Repository behavioral tests prove exact thesis, articulation version, and complete active signal-set binding with missing and stale target refusal

evidence-semantics-and-provenance.method: Repository behavioral tests prove thesis-centric invalidation polarity, direct-bearing requirements, neutral completeness, complete provenance, and promoted-claim reuse

deterministic-recorder.method: Repository behavioral tests prove the serializable recorder's exact permitted write set and atomic no-write outcomes for invalid inputs or changed targets

authority-boundary.method: Repository contract tests prove the exact adapter delegates its only mutation to the recorder and refuses status, Decision Item, claim creation, signal configuration, ad-hoc write, strategy, position, and trade authority

neutral-semantics.method: Compared the Codex adapter with issue #58's accepted contract, CONTEXT.md, the canonical assessment workflow's useful intent, and the governed thesis-underwriting dependency

eligible-environment.method: The configured repository runtime completed the non-mutating recorder --help preflight on 2026-08-08; database, source, provider, sandbox, or network unavailability remains an explicit unavailable result
